about: Benchmark 0003 evaluation corpus. Entirely synthetic: every person, pet, project, place-name pairing, amount and date is invented for this benchmark and describes no real individual. Records are captured at 09:00 UTC on the given date. A record with `corrects` supersedes the record it names. A claim's `path` is its full lifecycle, replayed through trusted restore. `unverified_link` stores the claim's evidence link without an evidence hash, so its support derives as orphaned. Families expand into one record per item, cycling through each list.

records.text: Bought a used steel touring bike at the Saturday market for 240.
The touring bike's rear brakes squeal on every descent.
Replaced the brake pads on the touring bike myself; the pads cost 35.

Caffeine after 2pm keeps me awake until midnight.

Started running along the canal; my target pace is six minutes per km.

Cloud models only ever see context I approved for that exact request.

Book club meets on Tuesdays at the library.
Correction: we switched to Wednesdays, at Elizabeth's flat.

Studio heating is broken; it was 14 degrees at the wheel this morning.
Blocked Sunday 8 to 12 in the calendar for pottery, no exceptions.
Stoneware mugs sold out at the spring market.
Nervous that the passport renewal won't arrive in time for Lisbon.
Lisbon day one: custard tarts, steep hills, sore feet.
Back from Lisbon; the tram 28 queue was not worth it.
Booked flights to Lisbon for 13 May, returning 20 May.
Car insurance renews on 1 March with Brightline.

Film night: watched A Room of Clocks; confusing in a good way.
Film night: watched Saltwater Hymn; the best one this year.
Film night: watched Marigold Static; skip it.
